title: Web Registration guide: myCourseBin, R/D sections, dropping (USC Registrar)
text:
Paraphrased from the official page by hand (Nov 2026).

Q: What is myCourseBin, and does adding a class enroll me?
A: myCourseBin works like a shopping cart; adding a class does not register you. You must Schedule it, then press Register and complete Checkout.

Q: I added a class but cannot finish registering. Why?
A: The usual causes are missing D-clearance or a time conflict. Unschedule the class, fix the issue (get clearance or change section), then register again.

Q: What do the R and D suffixes on a section number mean?
A: R means open registration (any eligible student may register). D means department clearance is required.

Q: How do I drop a class correctly?
A: Go to myCourseBin, choose Unschedule, then Drop. Unscheduling alone leaves you on the roster and may still charge tuition.
